reviews.body: Every run feels different and the story keeps rewarding you for dying. Easily my favorite roguelike.
Tough platforming with a surprisingly personal story. The assist mode is a great touch.
Perfect for winding down. I lost a whole weekend to my farm.
Exploring the world with almost no hand-holding is unforgettable.
Great atmosphere and fantastic bosses. A huge amount of game for the price.
Endless creativity, and even better with friends.
Smart puzzles and genuinely funny. The co-op campaign is a blast.
Charming, funny and surprisingly emotional. Worth playing blind.
